arguments.command:
git commit -q --amend -F - <<'EOF'
feat: log when an extension replaces a tool, and test overrides

A tool with the name of an earlier tool replaces it, as pi's registerTool
does. The log now says so. Tests cover wraps of tools and sections, their
order, and replaced tools. The docs describe overrides.
EOF
npx commitlint --from HEAD~1 --to HEAD && echo ok
